comment: +0: A/D digital filter constant (1/65536): the weight of the previous value - the channel's sensor_state_t.filter.coefficient points here and cm550_exponentialMovingAverage reads it (Calterm ...CS)
+2: global default value in the channel's units: filtered_value and the accumulator (<< 16) while the fault is active or on a tri-state reading (Calterm ...GD or ADDF + the channel code)

+4: A/D fault clear counts: debounce_counter at or below it clears fault_active_flag; each high / low status bit (0x806000) clears only while its 0x806040 first-occurrence bit is clear (Calterm ...CC or ...FC)
+6: A/D fault decrement: taken off debounce_counter on each in-range sample (floored at 0) (Calterm ...DT or ...FD)
+8: A/D fault increment: added to debounce_counter on each out-of-range sample (Calterm ...IC or ...FI)
+10: A/D fault set: debounce_counter at or above it sets the fault and is capped there (Calterm ...SE or ...FS)
+12: A/D high error limit in raw counts (0-1023): adc_raw_value above it counts toward high_error_fault_number (Calterm ...HL)
+14: A/D low error limit in raw counts: adc_raw_value below it counts toward low_error_fault_number (Calterm ...LL)
+16: the QADC result slot (0-39) whose right-justified result register (0xfff2b0 + 2 x n) gives adc_raw_value (Calterm ...CA: channel address)
+18: channel multiplexer setting: no reader in J90350.00 (0 in all 25 records) (Calterm ...MU)
+19: tri-state flag: nonzero makes a lookup result of 4 count toward tri_state_error_fault_number (0 in all 25 records) (Calterm ...TS)
+20: the fault the high limit sets (bit n mod 16 of status word n / 16 at 0x806000 / 0x806040) (Calterm ...HE)
+21: the fault the low limit sets (Calterm ...LE)
+22: the in-range / tri-state error: set at the fifth consecutive lookup result of 4 and cleared at the fifth other reading (Calterm ...TE)
+23: the channel runs once every sample_period passes of the A/D loop (0 = not processed); the e2m scale calls a pass 20 ms - not measured (Calterm ...SA or ...SR)
